relevant_sections.theme: Repair is not qualification; physical residual strength and hidden damage
Five-layer architecture, independent material truth, blind concealed faults
Independent destructive reference rather than model-to-model agreement
Stiffness recovery ratio requires matched load branch
Concealed moisture transport; backside wetting and gravimetric moisture map
Ultrasonic delamination mapping with destructive cross-section reference
Moisture-affected adhesion, lap shear and gravimetry
Mold-relevant wetness exposure and delayed hidden dampness

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: Grown BC may mechanically interlock through articulated plain-PLA links; surface coverage alone does not demonstrate interfacial bonding.
research_hypotheses.test: Cross-section optical/SEM and delamination/peel versus BC-only, PLA-only and post-assembled controls.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: Moisture may reduce the BC-PLA joint strength or preserve hidden wet paths even when the surface appears dry.
research_hypotheses.test: Conditioned dry/wet lap-shear or peel tests, gravimetric mass balance, independent moisture mapping and concealed-backside-wetting challenge.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: BC may immobilize articulated links, causing apparent stiffness increases while reducing flexibility, toughness or fatigue life.
research_hypotheses.test: Joint mobility count and force-displacement hysteresis, biaxial bending and repeated flexion with retained failed specimens.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: Controlled mechanical/thermal stimuli may produce distinguishable SkinGPT signals on a stabilized BC-PLA coupon but humidity and sensor mounting may create confounding drift.
research_hypotheses.test: Physical reference labels, matched mounting, wet/dry drift characterization and blind challenge against PLA-only and BC-only controls.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: A classifier may falsely declare a visibly intact BC-PLA coupon safe despite subsurface delamination.
research_hypotheses.test: Independent destructive ground truth on held-out hidden defects; report false-clears by severity and unknown/abstention cases.

research_hypotheses.hypothesis: PLA Glow optical readout can be studied as a physically and chemically separate module, but cannot be presumed suitable for live SCOBY contact.
research_hypotheses.test: Independent optical afterglow/dark controls and material-compatibility/leachate review before any material integration.

protocol.fairness: Freeze geometry, materials and thresholds before blinded tests; compare mass, thickness, wetness, mechanical boundary conditions, sensor positioning and instrumentation budgets. Samples from one growth vessel do not count as independent biological replicates.
protocol.proposed_stats: Exploratory pilot as in prior design (at least three independent growth vessels per growth arm after protocol freeze), then preregister sample-size/power plan for confirmatory work. Include all attempted samples and failures.
data_rules: No fabricated or substituted measurement values
Hash proves exact bytes, not physical truth
Qualify dry and wet mechanical claims separately
Do not transfer existing synthetic 346 MPa/13 GPa values to SCOBY+PLA

skinGPT_implementation_boundary.confirmed_repository_state: v0.3 experimental ESP32-S3 telemetry and rule-based heuristics; no trained GPT classifier or physically validated integrated SCOBY panel.
skinGPT_implementation_boundary.present_sensors: 8x NTC B3950 thermistors through CD74HC4067, one piezoelectric input, optional MPU6050 and AMG8833.
skinGPT_implementation_boundary.available_pipeline: ESP32-S3 NDJSON -> TCP receiver -> raw log -> calibration with provenance -> session manifest
skinGPT_implementation_boundary.new_research_extension: Proposed evidence labels and protocol only. No firmware/schema modification or field hardware actuation carried out by this record.

other_scoby_tracks.chitin_basalt: Keep filler-volume-fraction matched reinforcement tests separate; use F41 interface fracture and moisture challenges only as transferable methodology.
